Quick setup: create an OpenAI API key, then paste it into Settings.

  
Steps

  
    
    
  1. Open the OpenAI API Keys page
    2. 
    
  2. Click Create new secret key and copy it (you only see it once)
    3. 
    
  3. Back here: click Settings and paste the key into OpenAI API Key
    4. 
    
  4. Click Save, then run a test prompt
    5. 
  

  

    Open API Keys page
    
  

  

    Tip: Never share your key publicly. If it leaks, revoke it and create a new one.
  


  

    
Using Claude (Anthropic) instead?

    
Simply Agentic supports both OpenAI and Anthropic models. To use Claude:

    
    
      
  1. Open the Anthropic Console API Keys page
    2. 
      
  2. Click Create Key, name it, and copy it
    3. 
      
  3. Back here: click Settings and paste into Claude API Key
    4. 
      
  4. In each teammate's Edit panel, set their model to a Claude model
    5. 
    

    

      Open Anthropic Console
    

    
Claude models stream beautifully and are great for longer, more nuanced responses.

      How it works: Camera fills the background so you see yourself while reading. A 3-second countdown gives you a moment before scroll begins. Hit ● Record to start — it records camera + mic and scrolls at the same time. Tap anywhere to pause the scroll. Hit ⏹ Stop when done and download your take.
